Services > Human Risk
Human Risk Intelligence, Delivered
Tailored services that help you detect, investigate, and prevent human-driven threats both inside and outside of your organization.
Real Answers, Powered by People and Technology
Managing Human Risk, Empowering Your Business
Our human risk management (HRM) services are built to uncover, investigate, and reduce threats tied to people across your organization.
From executive protection to insider threat detection, we shape every engagement around your specific risks, needs, and organizational challenges.
Explore Human Risk Solutions
Human Risk Intelligence in Action
We provide end-to-end protection for executives with services that reduce risk, prevent exposure, and mitigate threats. Our assessments provide visibility into your digital footprint and awareness of exploitable risks of your key team members. We monitor for PII and other sensitive data that’s been exposed. We provide alerts and investigations for any threats to your employee and their family, and help reduce their PII exposure and digital footprint to minimize the risk of further threats.

How We Deliver Human Risk Intelligence
We help you investigate, assess, and monitor human-driven threats with extensive collection capabilities, expert analysis, and a powerful tradecraft to deliver finished intelligence that drives real outcomes.
Outside-In Intelligence
We operate where digital threats begin, across open-source, social, and dark web environments. From executive exposure to hiring risk, our assessments identify who is behind the threat and how they operate.
Expert-Led Investigations
Our analysts bring deep experience and proven tradecraft to every engagement. With a focus on context, clarity, and outcomes, we deliver real answers. Not just raw data.
Real-World Impact
Our intelligence drives action. Whether you need to reduce executive risks, disrupt insider activity, or pursue legal consequences, we provide the insight and evidence that protects against human risk.
It’s not just intelligence, it’s outcomes that protect your people and business.
Protection Across Key Risk Areas
Each of our human risk management solutions targets a specific type of human risk – so you can act with precision.
Leadership Protection
Safeguard high-profile leaders from targeted threats, digital exposure, and real-world risk.
Protect Your Executives Today >>
Insider Risk
Identify, investigate, mitigate internal threats, and data exfiltration within your organization.
Reduce Your Insider Threat Risk >>
Workforce Integrity
Detect fraud, false credentials, and pre-hire risk indicators.
Safeguard Your Workforce >>
External Relationships
Reveal hidden affiliations or risks among vendors, investors, or clients.
Protect Your Company from Third-Party Risks >>
“We trust and look to Nisos when support is needed to address complex security challenges. Throughout the course of our relationship, their ability to conduct tailored evidence collection and analysis to aid in our security investigations has enabled us to mitigate significant risks across cybersecurity, disinformation, fraud, and physical security.”
Andrew Stanley, CISO – Mars INC
Nisos Ascend™: Analyst Tradecraft in your Hands
Nisos helps you stay ahead of the people behind the threats. We combine our white-glove intelligence services with Ascend™, a client-facing SaaS platform that puts our proven tradecraft directly into your team’s hands.
White-Glove Services
Analyst-led, finished intelligence solutions give you a decisive edge over emerging threats.
– In-depth investigations that deliver answers – like attribution – that others don’t
– Full-service and end-to-end – from risk assessment and monitoring to threat mitigation and prevention
– A custom, curated relationship – built for your specific needs – that evolves with you
Ascend™ Platform
Client-led experience provides risk and threat visibility.
Includes:
– Rapidly surface risks and threats any time – day or night
– Dynamic, at-a-glance visualization of risk and ROI
– Powerful and accessible to easily scale with your needs and capabilities
– Confidence in spotting risks before they escalate
Through our hybrid approach we meet your team where they are to protect your people and organization.
Ascend modules include
Executive Shield
for executive digital protection and
Insider Threat Intelligence
for insider risk.
Learn more about Ascend >>

People:
